info.title: timelapse
info.description: The routes of the timelapse module. Every path is relative to the mount the host assigns.

get.summary: What the timelapse module is recording
get.description: The printer the camera watches, the storage and folder the videos go to, and, while a print runs, its name, the current layer, the frames kept so far and the last error. Asked with device, it answers this_printer for the tab of that printer. The host takes view_resource on the module's instance before this is called.

get.summary: The newest frame kept for the timelapse
get.description: A JPEG of the frame last chosen for the running or last print, at most 960 pixels wide. 204 when none was chosen yet. The host takes view_resource on the module's instance before this is called.
